ownership_and_errors.change: One Shared<BoxFuture<'static, ()>> owns the exact handle. It awaits that handle before acquiring the original result mutex, stores the actual Result once, then marks joined. Shared completion clones only unit; transport is never cloned.
ownership_and_errors.original_error: RecordedFailure::io and ::join and original Arc<dyn Error> objects are byte unchanged; original error kind/source preserved.
ownership_and_errors.cancellation: Cancel before/during actual join or while waiting to store/observe its result drops only a Shared clone or a short result-lock waiter. Registry still owns the same completion and result slot. No output can disappear between taking a handle and awaiting it.
ownership_and_errors.multiple_waiters: All waiters share the same physical join; the result lock still serializes unique transport take. Error results are retained for later observers.
ownership_and_errors.cycles: The shared future owns only the separate result Arc, which has no backreference to the completion or job. It does not introduce a job/completion/result self-cycle. The pre-existing actual launch-output custody is released by the same unique take/drop path.
ownership_and_errors.lock_scope: join() awaits completion before taking a result guard. join_original_stdio's launch output guard is confined to a lexical block and is gone before actual transport Drop, child notification waits or any following cleanup await.
